svg.aria-label: Warptiling changes which thread owns which 8 by 8 tile so that one warp covers a 64 by 32 block of C instead of a 16 by 128 strip. Per dot step the warp then needs 96 distinct floats from shared memory instead of 144, for the same 2048 FMAs.
svg.text: warp w owns thread-rows 2w, 2w+1 -> 16 rows x 128 cols of C
C tile: 16 x 16 thread tiles of 8 x 8
warp w owns a 64 x 32 block -> same 2048 outputs, squarer
C tile: 16 x 16 thread tiles of 8 x 8
